name: Austin Health Gender Clinic
title: Public endocrinology gender clinic
address: Endocrine Centre of Excellence, Level 2, Centaur Building, Heidelberg Repatriation Hospital, 300 Waterdale Rd
description: "Our Gender Clinic provides time-limited specialist endocrinology care for adults (aged 18 and over) who are: Seeking to commence gender-affirming hormone therapy, or Already on hormone therapy and experiencing issues or complications requiring specialist review." Shared care with the referring GP; referral required; up to three appointments then discharge to GP. Fridays 8.30am-12pm. Team: Dr Jasmine Zhu, Dr Anojian Koneshamoorthy, Dr Aviva Frydman (endocrinologists).
specialties: Endocrinology, gender-affirming hormone therapy initiation and complications

name: Professor Ada Cheung
title: Prof, Endocrinologist
practice: Prof Ada Cheung - Endocrinologist (private rooms); also Austin Health Transgender Clinic
description: Specialist endocrinologist whose scope of practice includes "Trans and Gender Diverse Health"; research focuses on "improving health outcomes for trans and gender diverse individuals" (leads the Trans Health Research Group) and she is an AusPATH policy committee member. Private clinic (Thursdays, GP referral required, waitlist of several months, out-of-pocket fees ~$230 first visit); she also works in the Austin Health General Endocrinology and Transgender Clinics, "which are bulk-billing clinics without any out-of-pocket costs." Telehealth available.
specialties: Endocrinology, trans and gender diverse health, gender-affirming hormone therapy, androgen deprivation therapy, thyroid, osteoporosis
